description: Header file defining interfaces for netlink communication in QUIC, including classes for parsing and manipulating network links, addresses, and routing rules on Linux systems.

classes.name: NetlinkInterface
classes.description: Interface providing methods for network link, address, and route management via netlink.

classes.name: NetlinkInterface::Verb
classes.description: Enumeration for netlink operation types (add, remove, replace).

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Virtual method to parse a netlink message.

methods.name: GetLinkInfo
methods.description: Retrieve link information for a specified interface.

methods.name: GetAddresses
methods.description: Retrieve IP addresses for a specified interface.

methods.name: ChangeLocalAddress
methods.description: Modify local IP addresses on an interface.

methods.name: GetRouteInfo
methods.description: Get routing rules from the main routing table.

methods.name: ChangeRoute
methods.description: Add, remove, or replace routing rules.

methods.name: ChangeRule
methods.description: Add, remove, or replace routing policy rules.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Send a netlink message to the kernel.

methods.name: Recv
methods.description: Receive a netlink message from the kernel.
